_meta.source: IMSBC Code (web-search hybrid: Marine Insight, BIMCO, P&I clubs, Wikipedia + Sonnet 4.6 training data) → 18 cargo profiles → 18× parallel pair generation → fail-closed symmetric merge → Haiku 4.5 cross-check. Variants/aliases via TAXONOMY in l5c-matrix.ts.
_meta.wildcard_semantics: C1 symmetric (unchanged from γ-2). Direct *→X contributes verdict; inverted *→X (matched against previous=X) contributes extra_clean and incompat-block but NOT compat:true.
_meta.symmetric_resolution: fail-closed: если X→Y compat:false ИЛИ Y→X compat:false — обе пары false. Safer для bi-directional contamination (residue stays in hold regardless of order).
_meta.next_phase: wave-γ-data-broker-review will incorporate Dubai/MENA broker spot-check decisions (current Haiku disagreement: 0/306 — broker review nonetheless recommended for high-value asymmetric pairs).

Sulphur residue with moisture forms sulphuric acid — corrodes pipe thread ends, epoxy/FBE coatings, and weld zones; pipes profile lists sulphur as incompatible. Hospital clean required but corrosion risk to threaded connections warrants fail-closed.

Sulphur profile lists salt as compatible; salt (NaCl) is chemically tolerant of sulphur residue and not food-grade sensitive in industrial form; however extra clean required (sulphur self-heating rule) and thorough fresh water wash to remove acid before salt loading to prevent hold corrosion acceleration.

Scrap metal is not food-grade and tolerates industrial contamination; sulphur residue corrosion risk is acceptable for scrap quality (scrap is already mixed ferrous fragments). Extra clean required (sulphur self-heating). Fresh water rinse essential to limit acid pitting of hold structure. Wet sulphur forms H₂SO₄ which actively corrodes steel surfaces and cargo; even residual sulphur dust with condensation causes acid pitting on steel coils/plates. Extra clean essential but corrosion risk too high without surveyor confirmation. Asymmetric: steel→sulphur is also listed incompatible in sulphur profile.

Sulphur profile explicitly lists sugar as incompatible; sulphur residue (SO2 odour, acid traces) causes food-grade rejection; sugar is hygroscopic and absorbs contaminants readily; surveyors will refuse grain-clean standard after sulphur without multiple washes. Symmetric.
